_comment: Corpus for everything Lore says that depends on a person's answers to the personality inventory (Services/MirrorInterpreter.cs): the Chart and answers reading, and the sentences added to the Report, the Daily and the Forecast. It holds the rules as well as the words. PLANETS. `dials` names groups of inventory facets by key (a minus counts a facet the other way up); each dial comes out low, mid or high: for several facets, when they average more than half a standard deviation from the reference group's mean; for one, more than a whole one (the line the profile itself draws). `expressions` are tried in order and the first whose `when` fits is used; a dial not named may be anything, and the last expression takes whatever is left. An expression's `lived` (well, strain, plain) is what is set against the planet's dignity in the chart; its `report` sentence goes into the Report ({name} is the person); `hard` and `easy` go onto a transit to that planet in the Daily and Forecast (hard: square or opposition; easy: sextile or trine; a conjunction takes hard when lived is strain and easy otherwise); `text` is the paragraph in Chart and answers. (`hard` and `easy` speak of "today" and are for the Daily reading; a pass in the Forecast, which lasts days or weeks, takes the sentence in `forecast` instead, by how the planet is lived.) `also` entries add a sentence whenever their `when` fits. `unlived` is said when the chart gives the planet an easy place and the answers describe strain; `hardWon` the reverse. SIGNS. `signs` gives, for the planet in each sign, the level of each dial the sign would lead one to expect. `nouns` names each dial for the sentences in `compare`, which say whether the answers match that expectation, exceed it or fall short. `rising` does the same for the Ascendant against the Extraversion trait. ASPECTS, ELEMENTS, MODALITIES. Sentences added under an aspect of the birth chart between two planets the answers both speak of (neither with its catch-all expression), by its tone and how each end is lived ({a} {ea}: a planet and its expression); and under an element or mode the chart leans toward (strong) or lacks (weak), by whether the facets in its `dial` are high or low. Expression names must read after "is": "Mars is held in". The pairing of chart factors with facets is Lore's own design: no research connects any questionnaire score with any factor in a chart. Nothing is generated at run time.

notes.intro: This reading sets two things side by side: what the chart says of each planet, and what the answers to the questionnaire say about the part of life that planet stands for. The chart is not changed. Only the wording here depends on the answers.
notes.invented: The pairing of planets with parts of the questionnaire is Lore's own, made by matching what each planet traditionally signifies with the facets that measure the nearest thing. No research connects a birth chart with measured personality, so an agreement here confirms nothing and a difference refutes nothing. It is a prompt for reflection.
notes.covered: Nine planets are read from the personality answers: the Sun, Moon, Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune, and the Ascendant with them. Pluto, the North Node, Chiron and Lilith are read from the character answers, when those have been given.
notes.untimed: This chart has no birth time, so Lore does not score how well each planet is placed, and there is nothing to set the answers against in the second part. Only the first part is given. The planets are placed for noon: the Moon may be seven degrees from where it is shown, so its aspects are left out, and a planet that changed sign on the day is not read by its sign.
notes.signUnsure: Without a birth time the sign {body} was in is not known{signs}, so the answers are not set against a sign.
notes.asWritten: The chart gives these an easy place and the answers describe them lived easily. The Report can be read as it stands.
notes.asWrittenHard: The chart gives these a difficult place and the answers describe difficulty there. The Report's account of the strain is the one being lived.
notes.noContrast: For these the chart's placement is middling, or the answers are, and there is nothing to set against anything.
notes.none: No planet shows a marked difference between the chart's account and the answers.
notes.closing: Where the two accounts differ, neither is the true one. The chart says what the tradition expects of a placement; the answers say how a person sees themselves on one day. The difference is the thing to think about.
notes.reportIntro: {name} answered Lore's personality inventory on {date}. Wherever a paragraph of this Report has a sentence beginning “By {name}'s answers”, everything from there to the end of that paragraph comes from the questionnaire and not from the chart: in the Overview, under each planet, under an aspect between two planets the answers speak of, and under the balance of elements and modes. The pairing of chart factors with parts of the questionnaire is Lore's own, and nothing in the chart has been changed by it. The full comparison is under Chart and answers in the Inventory view.
notes.reportNone: For none of the seven traditional planets do the answers go against what the chart's placement would lead one to expect.
notes.signs: For the Sun to Saturn the sign each planet is in leads one to expect more or less of certain things: push from a Mars in Aries, restraint from a Mars in Libra. Those expectations are set against the answers, and the reading says where the answers bear them out and where they go beyond or fall short. Uranus and Neptune stay years in a sign, which says nothing of one person, so they are read without it.
notes.summary: By {name}'s answers, taken as a whole: {list}.
notes.summaryAll: near the ordinary on all five of the broad traits
notes.summaryRest: near the ordinary on the rest
notes.coveredCharacter: Pluto, the North Node, Chiron and Lilith are read from the character answers, which are also what say how far each planet is being grown into.
notes.characterIntro: Personality describes a style. The character scales ask something else: how far a person has taken charge of their life, how they stand towards others, and whether they feel part of something larger. Those three are Cloninger's measures of maturity, and they are the nearest a questionnaire comes to asking how far a chart has been grown into.
notes.characterScale: These scores are read off the five-point scale itself, not against other people, because the IPIP publishes no reference figures for these scales. Their statements lean towards what most people would like to be true, so a middling score is not a poor one. The IPIP calls the scales preliminary.
notes.reportCharacter: {name} also answered the character scales on {date}. {list}
notes.reportLifeAreas: {name} last said how each part of life is going on {date}. Where that bears on a passage here, the Daily, Forecast and Timing readings say so.
notes.lifeHeading: Each house of the chart has a part of life that goes with it, and these are the ones marked out. The ratings are the person's own, as of the day they were given, and they change: answer them again whenever they stop being true.
notes.lifeStale: These ratings are more than six months old, so the other readings no longer use them. Answer them again to bring them back.
notes.lifeUntimed: This chart has no birth time, so it has no houses for the ratings to attach to. They are shown here and used nowhere else.
notes.changeIntro: Comparing this sitting with the one on {date}. Only moves of more than about one standard deviation are listed for a facet, or half a point for a scale: anything smaller is within what the mood of the day can do.
notes.changeNone: Nothing has moved by more than the mood of the day could account for since the sitting on {date}.
notes.sectionCharacter: How far it has been grown into

expressions.name: in full light
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers this is lived to the full: confident, ambitious and glad to be seen.
expressions.hard: By your answers you are sure of yourself and glad to be seen, so you are likely to meet this head-on. Check that it is the obstacle you are fighting and not your pride.
expressions.easy: By your answers you are confident and in good spirits. Today gives that room; use it for something that matters to you.
expressions.text: The answers describe someone sure of their abilities, ambitious, at ease with being noticed, and in good spirits about it. This is the Sun doing what it is said to do: a clear sense of who one is, shown without apology.

expressions.name: purposeful
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers it shows as purpose and confidence more than as enjoyment.
expressions.hard: By your answers you are driven and sure of your aims. A check today is more likely to redirect you than to stop you.
expressions.easy: By your answers you have purpose to spare. Today is a good day to enjoy some of what it has earned.
expressions.text: The answers describe confidence and ambition, without unusual lightness of heart. There is a strong sense of purpose and of being equal to it; the enjoyment of it is quieter, or kept for later.

expressions.name: dimmed
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers little of this is on show at present: confidence and spirits are both low.
expressions.hard: By your answers your confidence and spirits are both low at present, so a challenge may land harder than it should. Do not take today's measure of yourself for the true one.
expressions.easy: By your answers your confidence is low at present. Today offers some encouragement; let it in.
expressions.text: The answers describe doubt about one's own abilities, little push to excel, a wish not to be noticed, and few high spirits. Whatever the chart says of the Sun, it is not being shown: the sense of self is held back, or has been knocked.

expressions.name: unassuming
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers it is lived modestly, without any need to be noticed.
expressions.hard: By your answers you do not push yourself forward. Today may ask you to; it is all right to say what you want.
expressions.easy: By your answers you are content without notice. Some may come your way today all the same.
expressions.text: The answers describe modesty: no great claims for oneself, no hunger for achievement or attention. The mood is not low. This is a Sun that does not need to be seen, which is a way of living it and not a failure to.

expressions.name: good-humoured
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers it shows mostly as cheerfulness.
expressions.hard: By your answers good humour is one of your strengths. Today will test it, and it is the right tool for the day.
expressions.easy: By your answers you are cheerful by habit. Today meets you halfway.
expressions.text: The answers describe an ordinary measure of confidence and ambition, and more than the ordinary share of cheerfulness. The Sun shows here as warmth and good humour more than as drive.

expressions.name: sober
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers it is lived steadily and without much gaiety.
expressions.hard: By your answers you take things seriously. Today is serious enough without your adding to it.
expressions.easy: By your answers you do not make much of pleasure. Today, let yourself.
expressions.text: The answers describe an ordinary measure of confidence and ambition, with little gaiety. The sense of self is steady enough; it is not much given to enjoying itself.

expressions.name: steady
expressions.text: The answers describe an ordinary measure of confidence, ambition and cheerfulness: enough to get on with, not enough to dominate a room. The Sun is neither pressed forward nor held back.

Sun.unlived: The chart puts the Sun where it should shine without effort, and the answers describe self-doubt and low spirits. The tradition would say the confidence is there to be had. If that sounds wrong, ask what has stood in its way: the chart describes a capacity, and capacities can go unused for years.
Sun.hardWon: The chart gives the Sun a difficult place, where confidence is not supposed to come easily, and the answers describe someone who has it. On the tradition's own account that is not a gift but an achievement: a sense of self that was built and not handed over.
Sun.higher: The answers show this Sun on its higher side: purpose is chosen, and the person stands in their own life. The chart's account of self and aim can be read at its best.
Sun.lower: The answers show this Sun on its lower side: direction is unsure, and the self it describes may lean on approval or on grievance. The chart's account of self and aim is what could be, more than what is.

1.strain: Being seen is where the doubt sits: the self is on show here, and it costs.
1.well: The self is on show here and it can bear the looking.

2.strain: Worth and money get tangled: earning may be what is being asked to prove the self.
2.well: A settled sense of worth shows up here as steady earning.

3.strain: It comes out in talk: the need to prove something, or a reluctance to speak at all.
3.well: It comes out in talk and learning: a clear, ready voice in everyday things.

4.strain: The trouble goes home with it: a sense of self that the family formed, and that still answers to them.
4.well: The home is where this confidence comes from, and it is brought out from there.

5.strain: Pleasure and creative work are where this is tested: play can feel like a performance to be judged.
5.well: Pleasure and creative work are where this shines without trying.

6.strain: It goes to work: the self is measured by being useful, and is seldom useful enough.
6.well: It goes to work, and the daily round gets a person fully behind it.

7.strain: Partners carry the weight of it: the self is looked for in someone else's opinion.
7.well: Partners meet someone who does not need them to feel real.

8.strain: It runs deep and private: self-regard is at stake in what is shared and what is lost.
8.well: It is at its best in depth: a self that can bear being changed.

9.strain: Meaning is being asked to supply what confidence does not.
9.well: Meaning and study give this confidence its reach.

10.strain: Public standing is where this hurts: achievement is asked to settle the question, and does not.
10.well: Public life is where this comes into its own.

11.strain: It goes into groups: belonging is sought as proof.
11.well: It goes into groups and shared hopes, and others gather round it.

12.strain: It is hidden: much of this goes on where nobody sees it, the person included.
12.well: It keeps a quiet centre: strength that needs no audience.

expressions.name: tidal
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers these feelings run high, are closely watched, and unsettle.
expressions.hard: By your answers you feel things intensely and are easily unsettled, and today may stir that. What you feel is likely to be bigger than its cause; wait before acting on it.
expressions.easy: By your answers your feelings run high. Today they are likely to run somewhere pleasant.
expressions.text: The answers describe emotions that are felt intensely and that unsettle: worry, low moods and a sense of being overwhelmed, all closely attended to. The inner life is vivid and seldom at rest.

expressions.name: uneasy
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers there is more worry and strain here than this suggests.
expressions.hard: By your answers worry comes easily to you. Today may feed it; ask how much of it is today's and how much you brought with you.
expressions.easy: By your answers you carry a good deal of worry. Take today as a rest from it.
expressions.text: The answers describe a good deal of worry, discouragement or strain, without any unusual interest in feelings for their own sake. The unease is there more as a weight than as something examined.

expressions.name: deep and calm
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers these feelings are strongly felt and well carried.
expressions.hard: By your answers you feel a great deal and are steady with it. Today asks for exactly that.
expressions.easy: By your answers you are at home with your feelings. Today is a good day to share them.
expressions.text: The answers describe someone who feels a great deal and is not thrown by it. Emotions are noticed, valued and ridden out. This is the Moon at its most useful: sensitive without being fragile.

expressions.name: even
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers the feeling side is kept on an even keel, with little worry.
expressions.hard: By your answers you are hard to rattle, and likely to ride this out. Notice whether someone near you is taking it harder.
expressions.easy: By your answers you are settled in yourself, and can simply enjoy this.
expressions.text: The answers describe an even temper: little worry, few low moods, steadiness under pressure. Feelings do not run the day. Others may find this calm, or may sometimes wish for more reaction.

expressions.name: attentive
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers a good deal of attention goes to these feelings.
expressions.hard: By your answers you watch your feelings closely. Today gives you plenty to watch; you need not act on all of it.
expressions.easy: By your answers you pay attention to how you feel. Today that is a pleasure.
expressions.text: The answers describe ordinary emotional weather, closely watched: feelings are experienced strongly and given a good deal of attention, without more worry or low mood than most people have.

expressions.name: matter-of-fact
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers little attention is paid to this side of life.
expressions.hard: By your answers you do not make much of feelings. Today one may insist on being noticed.
expressions.easy: By your answers feelings are not much on your mind. Today is a mild invitation to notice a good one.
expressions.text: The answers describe ordinary emotional weather and little interest in it: feelings come and go without being much noticed or discussed. The Moon is quiet, by inclination more than by effort.

expressions.name: ordinary weather
expressions.text: The answers describe ordinary emotional weather: some worry, some low days, recovered from at an ordinary pace, and an ordinary awareness of it all. The Moon is neither troubled nor unusually calm.

Moon.unlived: The chart gives the Moon an easy place, where feelings should settle of themselves, and the answers describe worry and strain. The tradition would say the capacity for ease is there. The unrest may belong to present circumstances more than to temperament; it is worth asking which.
Moon.hardWon: The chart gives the Moon a difficult place, where the tradition expects feelings to be hard to live with, and the answers describe calm. If that calm is real, it has been learned. It is also worth asking, honestly, whether it is calm or distance.
Moon.higher: The answers show this Moon on its higher side: feeling is accepted, and it reaches other people as care. The chart's account of need is one that has been made room for.
Moon.lower: The answers show this Moon on its lower side: need goes into comparison and self-protection more than into closeness. The chart's account of feeling may describe a want more than a comfort.

1.strain: The feeling shows on the face: moods are hard to keep from others, and others respond to them.
1.well: The feeling shows, and it makes this person easy to reach.

2.strain: Comfort gets tied to money: security and spending both follow the mood.
2.well: Comfort and security are in steady hands here.

3.strain: It goes round in the head and comes out in talk: worry looks for words.
3.well: Feeling finds words readily, and a good talk settles things.

4.strain: It lives at home: the mood of the household is the mood of the person.
4.well: Home works as a real refuge: rest is found there.

5.strain: Pleasure and romance are asked to soothe, and do so only for a while.
5.well: Play and affection come easily, and restore the spirits.

6.strain: It reaches the body and the working day: the mood turns up as tiredness or a bad routine.
6.well: Daily routines keep the feelings in good order.

7.strain: A partner's mood is taken as one's own: closeness is where the unrest lives.
7.well: Close partnership is a real source of comfort.

8.strain: Feeling runs underground: it is intense, and hard to share with anyone.
8.well: Deep feeling can be borne and shared.

9.strain: Comfort is looked for far away: in another place, or another belief.
9.well: Faith or travel renews the spirits.

10.strain: Moods are carried into public: reputation and feeling are not kept apart.
10.well: The public finds this warmth easy to trust.

11.strain: Friends are asked for what they cannot always give.
11.well: Friends and groups feel like a second home.

12.strain: It goes where it cannot be seen: solitude both relieves and deepens it.

expressions.name: frank and inquiring
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers this mind enjoys ideas and speaks them plainly.
expressions.hard: By your answers you love an idea and say what you think. Today that may start an argument; make it a good one.
expressions.easy: By your answers you think freely and speak plainly. Today both are welcome.
expressions.text: The answers describe a love of ideas together with plain dealing: theory and argument enjoyed for their own sake, and no inclination to flatter, manoeuvre or dress things up. What is thought is said.

expressions.name: subtle
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers this mind enjoys ideas and is careful what it shows.
expressions.hard: By your answers you are quick with ideas and careful what you reveal. Today may press you to show your hand.
expressions.easy: By your answers you have a subtle mind. Today rewards the well-chosen word.
expressions.text: The answers describe a love of ideas together with a readiness to manage what others see: quick with theory and argument, and not above flattery or a well-placed omission. This is Mercury much as the old stories paint him, clever and a little sly.

expressions.name: inquiring
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers this mind is used for pleasure: ideas are enjoyed for their own sake.
expressions.hard: By your answers you enjoy an argument about ideas. Today may supply one.
expressions.easy: By your answers you love ideas. This is a good day for them.
expressions.text: The answers describe a love of ideas: theory, argument and difficult reading enjoyed for their own sake. The mind is being used for pleasure as well as for need.

expressions.name: practical
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers the thinking is kept to practical matters.
expressions.hard: By your answers you prefer the concrete. Today's confusion is best met by asking what, exactly, needs doing.
expressions.easy: By your answers you think to a purpose. Today things fall into place.
expressions.text: The answers describe a mind that prefers the concrete: little taste for abstraction or for discussion that leads nowhere. This says nothing about ability. It describes where thought is pointed, which is at things that can be used.

expressions.name: candid
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers what is thought is said, straight out.
expressions.hard: By your answers you say things straight. Today that may be heard as bluntness; say it kindly.
expressions.easy: By your answers you are straightforward with people. Today it is appreciated.
expressions.text: The answers describe an ordinary interest in ideas and unusual straightforwardness: no flattery, no manoeuvring, things said as they are.

expressions.name: politic
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers words are chosen with an eye to their effect.
expressions.hard: By your answers you choose your words with an eye to their effect. Today someone may want a straight answer.
expressions.easy: By your answers you know how to put things. Today that smooths the way.
expressions.text: The answers describe an ordinary interest in ideas and a practised hand with people: willing to flatter, to bend a rule, or to say what will work rather than what is so.

expressions.name: workaday
expressions.text: The answers describe an ordinary interest in ideas, taken up when they are useful or entertaining and put down again, and an ordinary measure of plain dealing. Nothing about Mercury stands out.

Mercury.unlived: The chart gives Mercury an easy place, where thought and speech should come readily, and the answers describe neither a love of ideas nor plain dealing. The questionnaire sees only these two sides of Mercury, so this is a narrow comparison: quickness in trade, craft or conversation would not show in it.
Mercury.hardWon: The chart gives Mercury a difficult place and the answers describe a real love of ideas. Whatever stands in the way of thought or speech in the chart, the interest has survived it.
Mercury.higher: The answers show this Mercury on its higher side: the mind goes to the problem, and what is said can be stood behind. Intelligence is being used, and used straight.
Mercury.lower: The answers show this Mercury on its lower side: the mind may stall or go to excuses, and honesty can give way under pressure. The chart's account of thinking is a capacity not yet relied on.

1.strain: It shows at once in how this person talks and comes across.
1.well: It shows at once: a quick and interesting talker.

2.strain: It reaches money and how it is reckoned: figures and promises want checking.
2.well: A good head for what things are worth.

3.strain: It runs through everyday dealings: errands, messages, neighbours and short trips.
3.well: Everyday dealings go well: this mind is in its own country.

4.strain: It stays home: what cannot be said elsewhere goes unsaid there too.
4.well: Thinking is done best at home, and home conversations count.

5.strain: It comes out in play, teasing and creative work.
5.well: Wit and invention make this person good company.

6.strain: It reaches work: details are where this shows, for better or worse.
6.well: It makes a fine worker's mind: careful, quick and useful.

7.strain: Partners hear it: agreements and quarrels both rest on how things are said.
7.well: Partners have someone who will really talk things through.

8.strain: It goes into secrets, money shared and things better not looked at.
8.well: This mind can go into hard subjects and come back with something.

9.strain: It reaches belief and study: opinions may run ahead of what is known.
9.well: Study and travel suit this mind well.

10.strain: It shows in public: reputation rests on what is said.
10.well: It makes a voice worth listening to in public.

11.strain: Friends and groups hear it first.

12.well: It works quietly and well on its own.

expressions.name: open-armed
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers affection is given freely: people are liked, sought out and trusted.
expressions.hard: By your answers you trust easily and like to agree. Today may ask you to hold a line; you can do it warmly.
expressions.easy: By your answers affection comes easily to you. Today it is returned.
expressions.text: The answers describe someone who likes people, seeks them out, trusts them and would sooner agree than argue. Affection is offered freely and relationships come easily.

expressions.name: charming on its own terms
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers company is enjoyed, with the guard kept up.
expressions.hard: By your answers you enjoy people and keep your guard up. Today may show you where the guard is costing you.
expressions.easy: By your answers you are good company on your own terms. Today you could afford to lower them a little.
expressions.text: The answers describe someone sociable and at ease in company who nonetheless keeps their guard up: slow to trust, and ready to contest a point. People are enjoyed more than they are relied on.

expressions.name: quietly devoted
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers this is kept for a few people, who are trusted completely.
expressions.hard: By your answers you keep to a few people and give way to them readily. Today, check that you are not giving way too far.
expressions.easy: By your answers your affection is kept for a few. Today is a good day to let one of them know.
expressions.text: The answers describe someone reserved, with little need of company, who trusts those they do let in and goes a long way to keep the peace with them. Affection is real and narrow: a few people, held closely.

expressions.name: guarded
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers people are kept at a distance, and little of this is being shared.
expressions.hard: By your answers you keep people at a distance, and today may seem to prove you right. Ask whether it has.
expressions.easy: By your answers you are slow to let people near. Today it may be safe to let one a little closer.
expressions.text: The answers describe distance from people on every count: little wish for company, little trust, and no reluctance to quarrel. Whatever the chart says of Venus, relating is being kept at arm's length.

expressions.name: sociable
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers it shows as ease and warmth in company.
expressions.hard: By your answers you are at ease with people. Today that ease is a resource: use it to say the awkward thing.
expressions.easy: By your answers company comes easily to you. Today it is likely to be good company.
expressions.text: The answers describe someone warm and fond of company, with an ordinary measure of trust and of willingness to give way. Venus shows as ease among people.

expressions.name: reserved
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers it is lived privately, away from crowds.
expressions.hard: By your answers you keep to yourself. Today may push you into company; you may leave when you have had enough.
expressions.easy: By your answers you are private by nature. Today offers company of the kind you might enjoy.
expressions.text: The answers describe someone who keeps to themselves: slow to make friends and happier out of a crowd, though no less trusting or agreeable than most. Venus is private here, not absent.

expressions.name: accommodating
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers it shows as trust and a readiness to keep the peace.
expressions.hard: By your answers you believe the best of people and meet them halfway. Today, make sure someone is meeting you.
expressions.easy: By your answers you are generous in your dealings. Today the goodwill comes back.
expressions.text: The answers describe an ordinary liking for company together with unusual trust in people and readiness to keep the peace. Venus shows as goodwill: others are believed and met halfway.

expressions.name: wary
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers it comes with little trust and a readiness to argue.
expressions.hard: By your answers you are slow to trust and quick to contest. Today will offer you a quarrel; you need not take it.
expressions.easy: By your answers you do not take people on trust. Today someone may earn a little.
expressions.text: The answers describe an ordinary liking for company together with little trust and a readiness to argue. People are kept company with and not quite believed. Venus is hedged.

expressions.name: moderate
expressions.text: The answers describe an ordinary measure of sociability, trust and give-and-take. Company is welcome in its place, and people are given the benefit of the doubt within reason.

Venus.unlived: The chart gives Venus an easy place, where affection and company should come without effort, and the answers describe distance and distrust. The tradition would say the warmth is available. Guardedness of this kind is more often learned than inborn; the chart suggests it need not be permanent.
Venus.hardWon: The chart gives Venus a difficult place, where relating is expected to be awkward or costly, and the answers describe someone open, trusting and at ease with people. That ease has been made, probably through relationships that taught it.

also.report: Art and beauty matter a great deal.
also.text: The answers also describe a strong response to art and to natural beauty: they are noticed, sought out and felt.

also.report: Art and beauty count for little.
also.text: The answers also describe little interest in art or beauty for their own sake.

Venus.higher: The answers show this Venus on its higher side: love extends to people as they are, and injuries are let go. The chart's account of relating has been lived into.
Venus.lower: The answers show this Venus on its lower side: affection keeps accounts, and what is owed is remembered. The chart's account of love may be more of a hope than a habit.

1.strain: It shows in how this person looks for welcome: the need to be liked is plain.
1.well: Charm comes readily, and people warm to it.

2.strain: Money and affection get mixed: spending is one way of asking for love.
2.well: A good eye for value, and comfort with money.

3.strain: It runs through everyday contact: small slights count.
3.well: Everyday dealings are pleasant, and other people are made easy.

4.strain: The home bears it: peace at home may be bought at some cost.
4.well: Home is made comfortable and kind.

5.strain: Romance and pleasure are the testing ground: they promise much.
5.well: Romance, pleasure and art all come easily here.

6.strain: It reaches work: colleagues are pleased or resented.
6.well: Working life is eased by goodwill.

7.strain: It goes straight to partnership: this is the first place it hurts.
7.well: It goes straight to partnership, and blesses it.

8.strain: Intimacy and shared money both carry it: trust is at stake.

9.strain: Love is looked for in the distant or the ideal.
9.well: Beauty in other places and ideas feeds this Venus.

10.strain: Public favour is sought, and is a poor substitute.
10.well: Public life goes smoothly on grace and tact.

11.strain: Friends take the place of something else, or are asked to.
11.well: Friendship is a true gift here.

12.strain: Love stays secret, or is not quite admitted.
12.well: Quiet affection, given without being seen, comes naturally.

expressions.name: combative
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers the drive is strong and so is the temper.
expressions.hard: By your answers you are forceful and quick to anger, and today offers a fight. Decide beforehand whether it is worth having.
expressions.easy: By your answers you have force to spare. Today it has somewhere useful to go.
expressions.text: The answers describe someone forceful, busy and quick to anger: ready to take charge and equally ready to flare. The drive is not in doubt. It comes with friction, and others will feel both.

expressions.name: direct
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers this drive is in full and well-governed use.
expressions.hard: By your answers your drive is strong and well governed. An obstacle today is more likely to be met than resented.
expressions.easy: By your answers you act readily and cleanly. Today that is likely to go well.
expressions.text: The answers describe drive that goes where it is pointed: assertive, active, glad of a challenge, and no more easily provoked than most. This is Mars working as it should, with force at the service of intention.

expressions.name: held in
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers this drive is felt more than it is used: the anger is there and the assertion is not.
expressions.hard: By your answers you feel anger more than you show it. Today will add to the store; say the thing before it says itself.
expressions.easy: By your answers your energy does not always find its way out. Today it has a clear road; take it.
expressions.text: The answers describe anger that is felt strongly and seldom acted on: little inclination to speak up or take the lead, and a quick temper underneath. Force that is not spent tends to turn into resentment, or to come out all at once.

expressions.name: muted
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers little of this drive is being called on.
expressions.hard: By your answers you seldom push. Today may push you; it is all right to push back.
expressions.easy: By your answers you let others set the pace. Today is a good day to set it yourself.
expressions.text: The answers describe little push and no unusual heat: no wish to lead, a slow pace, no taste for excitement. Others are left to decide. This is peaceable, and it can also mean one's own wants go unstated.

expressions.name: short-fused
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers the temper is quicker than the drive is strong.
expressions.hard: By your answers your temper is quicker than you might wish. Today will try it; count before you answer.
expressions.easy: By your answers small things irritate you easily. Today fewer of them will.
expressions.text: The answers describe an ordinary level of drive with a temper that is quickly roused. The energy is not excessive; the irritation is. Small obstacles cost more than they should.

expressions.name: even-tempered
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers it is lived coolly, with a temper that is hard to rouse.
expressions.hard: By your answers you are hard to provoke. Today tries, and is likely to fail.
expressions.easy: By your answers you act without heat. Today that makes things simple.
expressions.text: The answers describe an ordinary level of drive and a temper that is hard to rouse. What Mars does here it does coolly.

expressions.name: measured
expressions.text: The answers describe an ordinary measure of drive and of temper: able to push when it matters, not much inclined to fight for its own sake.

Mars.unlived: The chart gives Mars an easy place, where the tradition expects it to act cleanly and openly, and the answers describe anger with nowhere to go or force with too much friction. The directness is there to use. The question the chart puts is what is stopping it.
Mars.hardWon: The chart gives Mars a difficult place, where drive is expected to misfire, turn inward or cause trouble, and the answers describe energy that is direct and well governed. On the tradition's account that is a difficult placement that has been worked on.
Mars.higher: The answers show this Mars on its higher side: drive is under command, and anger does not linger as revenge. Force can be used when it is wanted, and stopped when it is not.
Mars.lower: The answers show this Mars on its lower side: impulse gets ahead of intention, and anger stays on after its reason has gone. Effort may turn against the person's own plans.

1.strain: It shows in the first encounter: people meet the edge of it before anything else.
1.well: People meet a person with energy and courage.

2.strain: Money is where the push goes, and where the fights start.
2.well: Earning gets this drive behind it.

3.strain: It comes out in words: arguments with neighbours, relatives or the road.
3.well: Quick decisions and direct speech serve well here.

4.strain: It stays at home, where it is hardest to walk away.
4.well: Energy goes into the home, and repairs and defends it.

5.strain: It comes out in pleasure: risk, rivalry and heat.
5.well: Sport, love and creative work take up this force gladly.

6.strain: It goes to work: the job takes it, or colleagues do.
6.well: It works hard, and gets things done.

7.strain: Partners take it: this is the classic place for the same quarrel to come round again.
7.well: Partnership has a plain, direct energy.

8.strain: It goes underground: desire and shared money are where it surfaces.
8.well: This force can go through crises and come out the other side.

9.strain: It is spent on opinions: beliefs become causes.
9.well: A cause or a journey gets the full force of this Mars.

10.strain: It shows at work and in public: authorities feel it.
10.well: Ambition has plenty of force behind it.

11.strain: Groups get it: allies and rivals are not always easy to tell apart.
11.well: It works well with others towards a common goal.

12.strain: It stays out of sight, and turns inward.
12.well: Effort goes quietly, behind the scenes, and pays.

expressions.name: lavish
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers this is lived expansively, and to excess.
expressions.hard: By your answers you reach for everything and find it hard to stop. Today may send the bill.
expressions.easy: By your answers your appetite for life is large. Today feeds it; mind the measure.
expressions.text: The answers describe a large appetite in every direction: eager for new experience, generous to others, and not good at stopping. Jupiter is plainly active. Its traditional fault, too much of a good thing, is active with it.

expressions.name: generous
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers this is lived generously and with a sense of proportion.
expressions.hard: By your answers you give freely and keep your sense of proportion. Today asks for the proportion.
expressions.easy: By your answers you are open-handed and know your limits. Today rewards both.
expressions.text: The answers describe someone who welcomes the new and gives freely to others, without being run by their appetites. This is Jupiter at its best: wide in outlook and open-handed, with a sense of proportion.

expressions.name: all appetite
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers the appetite is stronger than the reach.
expressions.hard: By your answers you find it hard to stop at enough. Today may test that.
expressions.easy: By your answers pleasure has a strong pull on you. Enjoy today, and look up from it now and then.
expressions.text: The answers describe strong cravings and little resistance to them, in a life that otherwise keeps to the familiar and does not go out of its way for others. Jupiter's excess is there without its largeness.

expressions.name: contained
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers this is lived within narrow, well-kept bounds.
expressions.hard: By your answers you keep within familiar bounds. Today may show you one that is too tight.
expressions.easy: By your answers you do not reach for much. Today something is within reach.
expressions.text: The answers describe a contained life: a liking for the familiar, a measured response to other people's needs, and appetites in hand. Nothing is overdone. Not much is reached for either.

expressions.name: indulgent
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers it shows mostly as a taste for pleasure.
expressions.hard: By your answers you give in to temptation readily. Today offers one with a cost.
expressions.easy: By your answers you like your pleasures. Today brings one; it will keep if you do not overdo it.
expressions.text: The answers describe an ordinary appetite for new experience and for helping others, and a stronger one for pleasure: cravings are felt keenly and often given in to.

expressions.name: temperate
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers it comes with unusual self-command.
expressions.hard: By your answers you have your appetites in hand, which is what today asks for.
expressions.easy: By your answers you are sparing with yourself. Today you can afford to be less so.
expressions.text: The answers describe an ordinary appetite for new experience and for helping others, with unusual self-command: temptation is easily resisted and little is overdone.

expressions.name: moderate
expressions.text: The answers describe an ordinary measure of adventurousness, generosity and self-indulgence. Jupiter is neither straining at the boundaries nor staying well inside them.

Jupiter.unlived: The chart gives Jupiter an easy place, where growth and good judgment are supposed to arrive together, and the answers describe appetite that outruns sense. The tradition would say the judgment is available: this Jupiter knows when enough is enough, if it is asked.
Jupiter.hardWon: The chart gives Jupiter a difficult place, where the tradition expects either meanness or excess, and the answers describe generosity with proportion. That balance was not the easy path for this chart.
Jupiter.higher: The answers show this Jupiter on its higher side: hope has an aim, and the wider view means something. Good fortune here is more than appetite.
Jupiter.lower: The answers show this Jupiter on its lower side: faith in the future is thin, and growth has no clear object. The chart's promise of expansion is waiting for something to expand towards.

1.strain: It shows at once: more of everything, in manner, in promises, in the body.
1.well: A generous manner and a good presence.

2.strain: Money and overreach go together here.
2.well: Luck with money, and sense enough to keep it.

3.strain: It runs through talk: more is said and started than finished.
3.well: A ready, hopeful mind in everyday things.

4.strain: It reaches home: too much is taken on there.
4.well: Home is ample, and open to others.

5.well: Pleasure and creative work bring real good fortune.

6.strain: Work suffers from too much being promised.

7.strain: Partners are asked to be everything.

9.well: Study, travel or faith reward this person fully.

11.strain: Too many friends and too many plans.

12.strain: It lives on hope in private, and little reaches daylight.
12.well: A quiet inner optimism carries this person through.

expressions.name: strict with itself
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers the discipline is real, and so is the fear of falling short that goes with it.
expressions.hard: By your answers you hold yourself to a high standard and fear falling short. Today's pressure is likely to feel heavier than it is.
expressions.easy: By your answers you are hard on yourself. Today the work shows; let it count.
expressions.text: The answers describe someone orderly, dutiful and careful who is also ill at ease under other people's eyes. The structure is real, and so is the fear of being found wanting that often drives it. Saturn is doing its work and exacting its price.

expressions.name: structured
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers this discipline is in daily use and sits easily.
expressions.hard: By your answers discipline comes naturally to you. A demand today is one you can meet.
expressions.easy: By your answers you are steady and organised. Today builds on that.
expressions.text: The answers describe self-discipline, order, a strong sense of duty and care before acting, without undue self-consciousness. This is Saturn as an asset: limits that are chosen and kept.

expressions.name: exposed
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers the discipline is missing and the self-consciousness is not.
expressions.hard: By your answers you feel judged and are short of structure to lean on. Today, do one small thing properly; it helps more than worrying.
expressions.easy: By your answers you are uneasy about falling short. Today is a kind day to put one thing in order.
expressions.text: The answers describe little structure and a good deal of self-consciousness: tasks put off, rules worn lightly, and a sharp sense of being judged. Saturn's fear is present without its discipline, which is the least comfortable way to have it.

expressions.name: unbound
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers these limits are, for now, declined.
expressions.hard: By your answers you wear rules lightly. Today one of them may insist.
expressions.easy: By your answers you are not much governed by plans. Today a little structure would cost you nothing.
expressions.text: The answers describe someone not much governed by plans, rules or tidiness, and not unduly troubled by what others think of that. Saturn's limits are being declined. This is freedom, and it is also work left for later.

expressions.name: self-conscious
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers it shows chiefly as unease about being judged.
expressions.hard: By your answers you are uneasy under other people's eyes. Today may put you there; they are looking less closely than you think.
expressions.easy: By your answers you feel others' judgment keenly. Today it is favourable.
expressions.text: The answers describe an ordinary measure of order and conscientiousness, and marked unease under other people's eyes. Saturn shows less as discipline than as the fear of being judged.

expressions.name: at ease
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers it is carried without anxiety.
expressions.hard: By your answers you are not afraid of being judged. Today that is an advantage.
expressions.easy: By your answers you carry your duties without anxiety. Today is light work.
expressions.text: The answers describe an ordinary measure of order and conscientiousness, and no fear of other people's judgment. Saturn's demands are met without anxiety.

expressions.name: moderate
expressions.text: The answers describe an ordinary measure of order and conscientiousness, and an ordinary measure of self-consciousness. Saturn's demands are met without being made a way of life.

Saturn.unlived: The chart gives Saturn an easy place, where discipline and authority are supposed to sit comfortably, and the answers describe either structure that is missing or structure held together by anxiety. The tradition would say that steadier ground is there. Fear is doing work here that habit could do instead.
Saturn.hardWon: The chart gives Saturn a difficult place, where the tradition expects heaviness, delay or fear, and the answers describe discipline worn lightly. That is the result Saturn is said to give to those who put the years in.
Saturn.higher: The answers show this Saturn on its higher side: limits are chosen, plans are kept, and problems are met. Discipline has become a form of freedom.
Saturn.lower: The answers show this Saturn on its lower side: limits are felt as defeat, and plans give way. The structure the chart asks for is still to be built.

1.strain: It shows at once: a guarded manner, and a hard judgement of oneself.

2.strain: It reaches money: fear of having too little whatever there is.
2.well: Careful with money, and slowly secure.

3.strain: It runs through speech and study: caution about saying anything.
3.well: Precise, patient and worth listening to.

4.strain: It lives at home: old rules still apply there.
4.well: A solid foundation, built with care.

5.strain: Pleasure feels like something to be earned.
5.well: Creative work given the time it needs.

6.strain: It reaches work: duty without an end, or duty dropped.
6.well: A workman's discipline, and a good one.

7.well: A partnership that lasts because it is worked at.

8.strain: Fear of what is shared, and of what is lost.
8.well: Able to bear the difficult things that others avoid.

9.well: Study has weight, and is finished.

10.strain: Public failure is the fear; it may drive or block the whole career.
10.well: Slow and very real public achievement.

11.strain: Groups are kept at a distance, and hopes low.
11.well: A reliable friend, and a pillar of any group.

12.strain: It works in private: self-reproach kept out of sight.

Uranus.stands: independence and the break with convention

expressions.name: unconventional
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers convention and authority are readily questioned.
expressions.text: The answers describe someone who questions authority, tradition and the established order, and welcomes change in how society is run. The questionnaire's statements here are about politics, so this is one narrow window on Uranus.

expressions.name: traditional
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers tradition and authority are respected.
expressions.text: The answers describe respect for tradition, authority and the established order. Whatever Uranus does in this chart, it is not showing as a quarrel with convention.

expressions.name: moderate
expressions.text: The answers describe neither a strong attachment to tradition nor a strong wish to overturn it. Uranus does not stand out.

Uranus.higher: The answers show this Uranus on its higher side: the unusual view has a purpose behind it. Difference is being put to use.
Uranus.lower: The answers show this Uranus on its lower side: restlessness has little to steer by. Breaking away may not yet be going anywhere.

expressions.name: porous
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers both the dreaming and the sympathy are strong.
expressions.text: The answers describe a vivid imagination and a tender heart: much time in daydream, and a ready response to other people's troubles. Neptune is fully present. The boundary between self and others, and between what is and what is imagined, is thin.

expressions.name: dreaming
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers the imagination is very active.
expressions.text: The answers describe a rich inner world of fantasy and daydream, with an ordinary or cooler response to others' misfortunes. The imagination is turned inward more than outward.

expressions.name: tender
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers it shows as sympathy more than as dreaming.
expressions.text: The answers describe ready sympathy for those worse off, without any unusual taste for fantasy. Neptune shows as compassion more than as dreaming.

expressions.name: matter-of-fact
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers little of this is in use: facts and fairness come first.
expressions.text: The answers describe someone who keeps to facts and judges by fairness more than by pity. Neptune is the least used planet here: little is dreamed and little is dissolved.

expressions.name: literal
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers the imagination is seldom called on.
expressions.text: The answers describe little daydreaming and an ordinary measure of sympathy. Neptune's imagination is not much called on; attention stays with what is in front of it.

expressions.name: unsentimental
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers pity plays little part.
expressions.text: The answers describe an ordinary imagination and little inclination to pity: other people's troubles are judged by what is fair more than felt. Neptune's compassion is not much called on.

expressions.name: moderate
expressions.text: The answers describe an ordinary measure of imagination and of sympathy. Neptune is neither prominent nor absent.

Neptune.higher: The answers show this Neptune on its higher side: imagination is alive and finds meaning in things. The dissolving side of this planet has found a use.
Neptune.lower: The answers show this Neptune on its lower side: there is little sense of anything beyond the plain facts, and the planet's longing may go unnamed.

Pluto.stands: power, compulsion and what must change

expressions.name: consumed
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers grudges hold and impulses win.
expressions.text: The answers describe injuries held on to and impulses that get their way. What this planet stands for is running the show: the old score and the urge to settle it. It takes more force to stop than to go on.

expressions.name: unforgiving
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers grudges hold, and are held under strict control.
expressions.text: The answers describe great self-command together with a long memory for injury. Nothing leaks, and nothing is let go. This is Pluto as a clenched hand: strong, and tiring to keep up.

expressions.name: worked through
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers old injuries have been let go, and intensity is under command.
expressions.text: The answers describe someone who forgives and who keeps their impulses under command. These are the signs of a Pluto that has been faced: the intensity has somewhere useful to go, and the past no longer gives the orders.

expressions.name: forgiving and unruly
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers injuries are let go readily, though impulses are not so easily ruled.
expressions.text: The answers describe a person who lets injuries go but cannot always rule their own impulses. Resentment is not the problem here. Compulsion may be: the urge is short, and the regret comes afterwards.

expressions.name: smouldering
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers injuries are not easily let go.
expressions.text: The answers describe grudges that last and a wish to see things evened up. This is Pluto below the surface: it may not show from day to day, and it does not go away.

expressions.name: able to let go
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers injuries are let go without much struggle.
expressions.text: The answers describe a person who forgives readily. A planet of endings has found one of its better uses: what is over can be allowed to be over.

expressions.name: compulsive
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers impulses tend to win, and are often regretted.
expressions.text: The answers describe things done and regretted, and chances thrown away. The pull of this planet is felt as compulsion: something takes over, and the person watches it happen.

expressions.name: contained
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers intensity is kept well in hand.
expressions.text: The answers describe someone who keeps to their plans and resists what would get in the way. Whatever this planet stirs, it is contained.

expressions.name: moderate
expressions.text: The answers say nothing out of the ordinary about grudges, compulsion or self-command, so they neither bear out nor contradict what the chart says of this planet.

Pluto.higher: The answers show this Pluto on its higher side: old injuries are let go, and intensity is under command. What this planet buries can be brought up and changed.
Pluto.lower: The answers show this Pluto on its lower side: grudges hold, and compulsion runs its own course. The planet's power may be working underground.

North Node.stands: direction, and where a life is heading

expressions.name: on its way
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers there is a direction, and it means something.
expressions.text: The answers describe someone who knows what they want and finds their life worth the effort. It is what the Node asks for: an aim that also feels like the right one.

expressions.name: purposeful and dry
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers there is a clear direction, though little sense of what it is all for.
expressions.text: The answers describe a clear aim and not much feeling for any larger meaning. The way forward is walked steadily. Whether it is the right road is not a question that troubles this person.

expressions.name: searching
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers much is felt to matter, and it is not clear where to go.
expressions.text: The answers describe a strong feeling for what matters and no clear idea of how to get there. Passion is here without a road: the person may go through many causes without settling on one.

expressions.name: adrift
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers there is no clear direction, and not much feeling that one is needed.
expressions.text: The answers describe a life without a clear heading, and a sense that it may not much matter. It is the hardest reading of the Node, and the one most worth questioning: this is how things look today, not how they must stay.

expressions.name: directed
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers there is a working sense of where life is going.
expressions.text: The answers describe someone who knows what they want and works at it. The Node's direction has been found, or something near it.

expressions.name: unsure of the way
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers the way forward is unclear.
expressions.text: The answers describe uncertainty about where life is going, and a readiness to let others decide. The chart's Node says where growth lies, and the person may be waiting to be told.

expressions.name: moved
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers a sense of meaning is strong here.
expressions.text: The answers describe a person moved by what they take up. There is feeling behind whatever direction is chosen.

expressions.name: moderate
expressions.text: The answers say nothing out of the ordinary about direction or meaning, so they neither bear out nor contradict what the chart says of the Node.

North Node.higher: The answers show this Node on its higher side: there is a direction, and it feels worth following. The chart's line of development is one being walked.
North Node.lower: The answers show this Node on its lower side: the way forward is not clear, and may not seem worth the trouble. The chart's line of development is still to be taken up.

Chiron.stands: the old hurt, and what it has taught

expressions.name: healing
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers the self is accepted, and that acceptance reaches other people.
expressions.text: The answers describe someone settled in themselves and alert to what others feel. It is the classic turn of Chiron: a hurt that has become understanding, offered to people who have the same one.

expressions.name: wounded healer
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers others are looked after better than the self.
expressions.text: The answers describe care for others alongside a harsh measure of oneself. It is Chiron's commonest form: comfort given freely to everyone but the person giving it.

expressions.name: settled
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers the self is well accepted, though others' pain is not much attended to.
expressions.text: The answers describe a person at peace with themselves and not much drawn to others' troubles. Whatever hurt the chart points to, it has been put down. It has not been turned into care.

expressions.name: armoured
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers the old hurt is kept behind status and distance.
expressions.text: The answers describe a concern with standing and little attention to what others feel. This may be a hurt kept out of sight: nobody gets close enough to touch it, and it does not get better.

expressions.name: at peace with it
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers the person is on good terms with their own shortcomings.
expressions.text: The answers describe someone with little need to compete or impress. The sore place this body points to does not appear to be running things.

expressions.name: sore
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers comparison with others keeps a sore place open.
expressions.text: The answers describe a person much taken up with status and with not looking weak. The hurt this body points to may lie under that.

expressions.name: tender to others
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers others' pain is noticed and answered.
expressions.text: The answers describe someone who picks up what others feel and makes time for them. Chiron's lesson is being applied.

expressions.name: unmoved
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers others' pain is not much attended to.
expressions.text: The answers describe someone who does not go out of their way for what others feel. This body's lesson, if it has been learned, is not in use.

expressions.name: moderate
expressions.text: The answers say nothing out of the ordinary about acceptance or care, so they neither bear out nor contradict what the chart says of this body.

Chiron.higher: The answers show this Chiron on its higher side: the old hurt is accepted, and has turned into understanding of others. It is the healer's side of this body.
Chiron.lower: The answers show this Chiron on its lower side: the old hurt is still kept out of sight, behind status or a hard front. It is the wounded side of this body.

Lilith.stands: what was refused, and what will not be tamed

expressions.name: at large
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers there is little sense of being wronged, and no trouble standing up.
expressions.text: The answers describe someone at ease with their life and able to meet what comes. What Lilith holds has no need to rage: it can simply go its own way.

expressions.name: embattled
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers a sense of being wronged goes with the strength to fight it.
expressions.text: The answers describe a person who feels short-changed and is quite able to take that on. This is Lilith with a cause: forceful, and easily set off.

expressions.name: swallowed
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers a sense of being wronged goes with little strength to answer it.
expressions.text: The answers describe a person who feels used and finds it hard to stand up to it. What Lilith holds is turned inward: refusal never quite said, and anger with nowhere to go.

expressions.name: easy-going
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers there is little grievance, and little appetite for a fight.
expressions.text: The answers describe contentment and a readiness to let others lead. Whatever this point stands for, it has not been a battle.

expressions.name: unaggrieved
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers there is little sense of having been wronged.
expressions.text: The answers describe someone at ease in their life and not looking for slights. What this point holds has been let be.

expressions.name: aggrieved
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers a sense of having been wronged is near the surface.
expressions.text: The answers describe feeling short-changed, misunderstood or used. It is Lilith's first form: the refused part that has not forgotten.

expressions.name: self-possessed
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers the person stands on their own feet.
expressions.text: The answers describe a person who faces problems directly and does not wait to be led. This point's independence is a working one.

expressions.name: held back
expressions.report: By {name}'s answers it is easy to be discouraged or overruled.
expressions.text: The answers describe someone easily discouraged or intimidated. What Lilith holds may go unused for lack of nerve.

expressions.name: moderate
expressions.text: The answers say nothing out of the ordinary about grievance or nerve, so they neither bear out nor contradict what the chart says of this point.

Lilith.higher: The answers show this Lilith on its higher side: what was refused has been made peace with, and no longer needs to be proved against anyone.
Lilith.lower: The answers show this Lilith on its lower side: a sense of having been wronged is near the surface, and it may be spent on the wrong people.

compare.asExpected: Against the sign: much as {body} in {sign} would suggest.
